d.t: MESH BRACKET FOR WALL MOUNTED LANDSCAPE GREENING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket is a bracket to mount steel wire meshes onto walls to create green wall facades. Brackets are manufactured from stainless steel (SUS 304), and it has two anti-lift arms to prevent removal of the wire mesh. SikaRoof VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiWall GP 2060, SikaRoof VersiWall GP 2020, SikaRoof VersiWall GP 250 and SikaRoof VersiWall GP 150 with a steel wire mesh to create a green wall system.
a: Bracket to hold steel wire mesh
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Brackets are used to create green walls on either internal or external wall facades.
d.pk: SikaRoof VersiWall GP Mesh Bracket SUS304 Refer to pricelist

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.

Products must be stored in their original packing, in their original box, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
